relations.description: UE may include extended DRX parameters IE during attach procedure.
UE may include extended DRX parameters IE during tracking area updating procedure.
Use of eDRX is prohibited if UE has PDN connection for emergency bearer services.
Successful PDN disconnect procedure for emergency services resumes eDRX.
Successful EPS bearer context deactivation for emergency services resumes eDRX.
Successful service request procedure enables eDRX use after local emergency connection release.
Stored UE specific DRX parameter is used if eDRX is not accepted or emergency bearer exists.
Network uses stored DRX parameter with old GUTI and eDRX with new GUTI during GUTI reassignment.
